corpus.book_span_derivation: TOC region = bytes until SECOND occurrence of the Old Testament header; titles = non-empty TOC lines minus the two section headers; book i heading = FIRST occurrence of its exact title line after book i-1's heading; span = [heading_i, heading_{i+1}), last ends at EOF
corpus.tokenization: byte ids 0..255 (utf-8); preregistration section 1 tokenizer with max_phrases=0

projection_rule: humanbrain.sdr_union.SDRProjector: default_rng((seed, n, w, token_id)).choice(n, w, replace=False), sorted
purpose: empirical validation of the w^2/n union-capacity claim across lambda x n x w before the U-STATE D3 probe suite spends compute

recommendation.rule: among configs retaining >=1% sparsity (untouched-bit fraction under a 1e-2 floor) at 800-token windows, minimize pooled median window-end cosine; tie-break on share of pairs above 0.90
